title: Exact Walled-Brauer B_{3,1}(d) Classification of Choi-Splitting NPT Bound Entanglement: Sharp Barrier d_min=8, Universal All-d>=8 Witness, Theta(sqrt(d)) Depth Scaling, and the d=4 Separable-Mixture Gap
abstract: We settle four fundamental structural questions left open by Faisal's (arXiv:2611.34921v1) breakthrough proof of NPT bound entanglement via U(d)-covariant Choi-splitting SDPs, with 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice), 16 zero-float SHA-256 certificates, and 57 adversarial tests: (1) an irrationality-free rational 5-irrep Walled-Brauer B_{3,1}(d) reduction (capturing the exact faithfulness transition from rank 23 / 4 active blocks at d=3 to faithful rank 24 for all d>=4); (2) nine exact integer continuum dual Farkas certificates refuting all U(d)-covariant product maps for d in {3,4,5,6,7} (establishing the sharp universal barrier d_min=8); (3) a single explicit closed-form quadratic polynomial family Q(d) certifying NPT bound entanglement for every integer d>=8 simultaneously with all 28 Sylvester minors strictly positive in u=d-8>=0; (4) the first machine-checked Lean 4 verification of Faisal's d=8 witness, a +33.99% deepening at d=8 to (-beta)*8=1980/1871, and a certified Theta(sqrt(d)) NPT depth ladder up to d=256 reaching (-beta)*256=179712/26615; and (5) an exact d=4 rank-2 separable-mixture certificate satisfying all four Choi-splitting conditions (2a)-(2d) at (-beta)*4=101/100>1 with non-factorizability determinant p0*p3-p1*p2=-5358237!=0, pinpointing Faisal's Lemma 5 single-tensor adjoint factorization as the exact mechanism separating d=4 from d_min=8.
